featured_reviews.name: Arpit Goyal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointing Experience – Not Worth the Money

My experience with BSE Institute has been extremely disappointing. The institute makes big claims about quality education and industry exposure, but the reality is completely different. Many of the faculty members are highly unprofessional, lacking both teaching skills and real-world expertise. Instead of focusing on delivering quality education, they pressure students to write positive reviews, which is why most of the feedback online is completely manipulated.

The course content is outdated, and the learning experience is far below expectations, especially considering the high fees they charge. There is little to no proper guidance, and many sessions feel like a waste of time. They market themselves as a top-tier institute, but in reality, they fail to provide any real value to students.

If you’re thinking of joining BSE Institute, I strongly recommend reconsidering. There are far better options available that actually care about students’ growth rather than just making money. Don’t fall for the hype!

featured_reviews.name: Mikey
featured_reviews.review_text:
While the institute carries a reputed name and offers valuable programs, the management and coordination team require serious improvement. The experience with Chitralekha ma’am and the coordinators has been extremely disappointing — they are often unresponsive, unhelpful, and at times, quite unprofessional in their approach toward students. Many students face unnecessary delays, lack of communication, and at times, are even made to wait outside the office for long durations without clear updates or support.
The administrative attitude reflects poor management standards, and such behavior creates unnecessary stress for students. Until there’s a significant improvement in the way the management team handles student concerns, I would not recommend taking admission here.

That said, the teaching faculty is excellent — highly knowledgeable, supportive, and genuinely invested in students’ learning. The academic experience is good, but unfortunately, the management’s inefficiency overshadows
If the administration becomes more student-friendly and responsive, BSE Institute could truly live up to its strong academic potential.
I understand that after sharing honest feedback, the management might try to identify the student and label this as “defamation.” However, this review is not written to defame anyone — it reflects genuine student experiences that deserve attention.

Instead of silencing feedback, I hope the institute chooses to listen, reflect, and improve. A truly reputed educational institution should value transparency and accept constructive criticism with professionalism.

The counsellor assured us that admission was “100% guaranteed” and also stated that if admission was not secured in any university, our money would be refunded. However, by June 2026, all five universities we had selected rejected the application. When we asked for the reasons for the rejections, we did not receive clear answers. Our WhatsApp messages and emails often went unanswered.

We also requested a refund based on the assurances given to us, but we are now facing delays and avoidance. In addition, we were never provided access to the application portal, leaving us completely dependent on the consultancy for updates and unable to track the process ourselves.

Based on our experience, I strongly advise students and parents to insist on full transparency, written commitments, portal access, and clear documentation before making payments or taking education loans.
